scope: One bounded saved-state line-search diagnostic and equivalent-arithmetic repair if justified; no physical model, force, material, trajectory or tolerance change.
failure: exception: Contact Newton line search failed
diagnostic: Reproduce original solve without fracture commit; inspect residual and energy-difference trace.
candidate: Compute convex contact/ground energy increments with nonnegative Bregman remainders instead of subtracting nearly equal large potentials; independent high-precision controls required.
retest: One isolated step plus same-state two-half-step comparison; preserve all force/geometry/residual limits.
